messages:
emma.sales: Polaris Health returned the SIG; they marked Q12 (data residency), Q23 (KMS rotation), and Q45 (vendor access) as must-have before legal signs. Need 2-line answers + attachments per Q. Can we triage?

jordan.sec: I can take Q23 and Q45. Will pull the KMS rotation timeline and our vendor access controls one-pager.

leo.platform: I'll handle Q12 (data residency) and provide the hosted-region proof and private deployment statement. Note: hosted tenants can be pinned to eu-west-1; will attach the region-pinning excerpt.

maria.support: I have the SOC2 cert and the encryption-at-rest summary (includes AES-256-GCM and DB encryption notes). Uploading to shared SIG folder now.

emma.sales: Good. Polaris specifically asked "Which regions store backups?" and "How do you prove keys are rotated?" Keep answers short and reference attachments.

jordan.sec: Draft for Q23: "Automated tenant key rotation monthly; CMKs rotated annually; rotation events forwarded to audit logging and SIEM. Sample rotation audit log attached." Adding sample log snippet:
```
2026-03-15T17:03:12Z PUT /kms/rotate key_id=xyz-789 user=key-admin status=success request_id=abcd1234
```

leo.platform: For backups: hosted backups are region-constrained to the same region as the tenant by default; cross-region backups only enabled with signed request. Private deployments: backup location per-customer. Attaching `backup-region-policy.pdf`.

maria.support: Uploaded: att-1 SOC2-2026.pdf, att-2 encrypt-summary.pdf, att-3 backup-region-policy.pdf, att-4 kms-rotation-log-sample.txt. I updated the SIG spreadsheet rows S8-S11 with links.

emma.sales: Jordan, can you include the subprocessors list + background check summary for Q45? Polaris needs names and whether subprocessor access to data is allowed.

jordan.sec: Yes. Short answer: "Subprocessors listed in att-5; subcontractor access limited to specific roles, data access requires least-privilege approval and is logged. All staff with privileged access have background checks per HR policy." Attaching `subprocessors-2026.pdf` and `background-checks.md`.

sig-bot: Reminder: Polaris Health SIG deadline in ~36 hours. Upload artifacts to https://redwood-internal.docs/sig/uploads/PolarisHealth 

emma.sales: Can someone own final spreadsheet QA? I want all Q cells populated + attachment links and a 1-line summary for legal. I'll review before sending.

leo.platform: I'll do a pass on the spreadsheet and standardize the phrasing by EOD.

maria.support: Verified SOC2 cert date and updated spreadsheet cell S9. All uploads completed.

emma.sales: Thanks team. Plan: finish QA tonight, send to Polaris tomorrow morning, offer 30-min walkthrough if they want. Ping here if any missing bits. :thumbsup:
